v1_statement: The pre-registered P5-N2 v1 vacuum validation is final and permanent: all nine SGB screening candidates INCONCLUSIVE / NOT ELIGIBLE, credible set empty, gate 3 FAIL. This audit re-scores nothing, re-labels nothing, and changes no limit, table, criterion or tolerance. Official statuses are read from hallthruster_bridge/validation/p5_n2_campaign_v1_vacuum_scores.json.
numbers_from: docs/chemistry/n2_domain_extension/domain_extension_requirements.json (scripts/chemistry/n2_domain_extension_requirements.py); every number here is {value, from} and re-checked by tests/test_n2_domain_extension_audit.py

value.C1_coverage: share of the table's declared-model Maxwellian rate at L from energies above the last point covered by accessible published cross sections (the table's own sources plus independent sets passing C3) < 1 % (the rate_validity.toml convention, applied to the covered range)
value.C2_shape: for every independent set passing C3, replacing the table's sigma above its own last source point by that set's shape (scaled to the table at the join) changes the rate at L by < 1 %
value.C3_join: the independent set agrees with the table at the table's last source point within the stated uncertainty (combined in quadrature where both are published; the table's alone where the set's is not accessible)

readings.measured: C1 counts only MEASUREMENT-BASED independent sets: measured, or reconstructed by arithmetic from measured sets (e.g. Winters' neutral points = measured N-atom deposition minus measured dissociative ionization); digitized from a secondary figure allowed
readings.evaluated: C1 also counts EVALUATED/recommended sets (secondary reproductions of abstract-only primaries)

verdict_map.SUPPORTED: measured reading passes at >= 60 eV; proposal = largest candidate L passing (DRAFT)
verdict_map.PARTIAL: only the evaluated reading passes at >= 60 eV, or the table content is supported but a documented omission needs the completeness re-audit
verdict_map.UNSUPPORTED: accessible independent evidence passing C3 fails C2 at 60 eV
verdict_map.UNRESOLVED-BY-SOURCE: no accessible independent set above the table's last source point passes C3

value.not_a_criterion_change: C1 re-uses the existing 1 % convention; nothing in v1 (f_out tolerance, limits, criteria) changes

dissociation_N2.dat.reasoning: Three published descriptions above 200 eV are accessible, all via the vector Fig. 19 of Song 2023: one measurement-based (Winters' neutral points, reconstructed from measured data, to 296 eV) and two evaluated (to ~1 keV). None is independent of Table 9 at the 200 eV join (Table 9 averages Cosby and Winters; MS1997 used Cosby), so C3 there is a consistency check, not an independent test; the independent content is the > 200 eV part only (for Winters, two points). All three fall above 200 eV, so the table's held tail is an upper envelope. Winters (measurement-based, within the combined uncertainty at 200 eV) covers the energies carrying the rate at 60 eV to within 0.47 % (C1), and replacing the held tail by any accessible shape changes the 60 eV rate by <= 0.35 % (C2). 75 eV passes only in the evaluated reading (Winters ends at 296 eV; C1 1.7 %), with a shape impact of 0.93 % that is within 0.1 % of the 1 % convention; it is not proposed. Neither 1e-6 nor 1e-12 coverage is available at any candidate limit from a measured set (E_req(1e-6) at 60 eV = 664 eV).
conditions: table unchanged (no rebuild); proposal concerns the validity limit only
the fixed 12.14 eV energy loss is supported by Cosby's 48.5 eV translational spectra only; its model uncertainty 9.75-13.33 eV stays carried
Kawaguchi 2021 is 25 % below Cosby at 200 eV (outside +-20 %): a normalisation disagreement that also exists inside the v1 domain (0.76 at 50 eV); recorded, not resolved here
the SUPPORTED verdict rests on two reconstructed Winters points above 200 eV (about 246 and 296 eV), digitized from a secondary figure; whether that suffices is an owner decision (D-X12)
what_would_change_the_verdict: measured data between 296 eV and ~330 eV (E_req(1e-2) at 75 eV is 327 eV); 90 eV also fails C2 for the unchanged table (held-tail bias 1.86 %)
the MS1997 / Kawaguchi full texts showing how their >200 eV parts were built (evaluated reading)

completeness_implications.rule: the extended-domain re-audit must be pre-registered (domain, processes, denominators, thresholds F_P 1 %, F_ion 1 %, F_S 5 % unchanged unless the owner decides otherwise) and completed before any v2 run

owner_decisions: D-X1: open a v2 at all? Evidence supports extending only dissociation_N2.dat (to 60 eV, measured reading); applied alone it would newly cover about 6 of 714 v1 OOD runs (proxy), 22 under the evaluated reading
D-X2: coverage reading: measured-only (default here) or evaluated-inclusive (secondary reproductions of abstract-only evaluations)
D-X3: extension threshold: the existing 1 % convention (used here) or 1e-6 / 1e-12 (no accessible measured set supports any extension at those levels)
D-X4: join-consistency tolerance (C3): source uncertainty, combined in quadrature; treatment of sets whose uncertainty is not accessible (MS1997, Kawaguchi 2021)
D-X5: seek legitimate full-text access (library/purchase, no paywall bypass, no LXCat) to Kawaguchi 2021, Majeed & Strickland 1997, Itikawa 2006, Cosby 1993, Winters 1966

D-X6: dissociation: keep the held tail (unchanged table) or rebuild with an evidence-shaped tail (a model change: every run reruns); whether the Kawaguchi -25 % normalisation warrants a chemistry variant
D-X7: vibrational: keep 'resonant only' above T_e 30 eV, add non-resonant excitation (model change), or bound it in the completeness re-audit
D-X8: rotational: accept a theory-only envelope above 10 eV or keep 45 eV
D-X9: electronic (7 states): the MS1997 vs Johnson conflict at 50-100 eV (inside the v1 domain) - record only, or carry as a chemistry variant in a future version (never in v1)
D-X10: pre-register the extended-domain completeness re-audit (domain, processes incl. dipole-allowed states and multiple ionization)
D-X11: v2 run scope and whether the driver should save per-frame T_e / activity so a future limit change can be evaluated without reruns (bridge_lib.jl change: owner)

D-X12: whether two reconstructed Winters points above 200 eV (measured N deposition minus measured dissociative ionization), digitized from Song 2023 Fig. 19 and not independent of Table 9 at the 200 eV join, are sufficient evidence for the draft dissociation extension to 60 eV
